_readme: SEC-UG-NON-INTERFERENCE-PROOF-FOR-EVERY-EXPOSED-FUNCTION-AND-TABLE-20261111 (#8323). Reviewed volatility contracts for tests/non-interference-db.test.js. The proof sweeps each world twice without the neighbour and learns nothing from those runs: an answer that differs between them fails as unproven unless its target is listed here. Keys are "function:<exact signature>" or "table:<name>"; each names field paths ("$" is the answer, "[]" any row) and, per path, the anchored pattern the WHOLE value must match to be masked, with the reason the call makes it fresh each time. A value in that field that does not match is compared as it is. The proof cannot show that a call generated an id, so every rule that masks an id (in a successful answer or in a refusal) is marked notProven with record 8359: the function must be on the #8359 not-proven list (unreachable.json, as unreached or in its reached-but-not-proven list) and is reported not proven. Only values that are random by design and are not ids (a new secret, a recovery code) are masked by their pattern alone. A function's row order counts unless an "unordered" entry reviews it as unspecified. A contract whose target no longer varies fails as unused.
